description: Ramadan Kitchen: Iftar Preparation Ambience Experience the warmth and gentle rhythm of a home kitchen as Iftar is prepared during Ramadan. This immersive ambience captures the soothing sounds of food preparation as a hearty lentil soup bubbles away on the stove. The gentle stirring of the pot, the occasional clatter of dishes being packed away, and the crisp chopping of onions and parsley blend together to create an authentic, homely atmosphere. Knives, forks, and spoons clink in the background, adding layers of realism to the recording, while the subtle undertones of movement and preparation evoke the anticipation of a shared meal. This recording is perfect for sound designers, filmmakers, and anyone looking to recreate the essence of a cozy kitchen setting during Ramadan. Whether you need a rich culinary ambience for a documentary, a film, or a meditative soundscape, Ramadan Kitchen brings the warmth of family and tradition to your audio project. Campsite shared bathroom / toilets atmosphere. 
I made this recording in the shared bathroom / toilets of a small campsite located near Gérardmer, in the east of France. 
 First, one can hear a lady cleaning the appliances of the shared bathroom / toilets and flushing the toilets. Then, at about #2:30, a man comes, and he will use a sink and brush his teeth (after #5:00) while the lady cleaner is still busy. He will finish at about #7:15, then he will go away while kids are playing in the distance. 
Recorded in August 2024 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Sound Professionals MS-SPSM-1 microphone (Primo em-258)
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity.

name: park sping NL12.55 PM 220503_0341
description: Ambience of wind in the fields, park with bushes, pond and trees in Dutch spring. Located close to village Drunen in North-Brabant. Many birds because of spring. Some wind. The cuckoo invisibly sings her afternoon concert together with the European Pied Flycatcher. In the backbround the local traffic. The Baardwijkse Overlaat (overlaat = a river flood area), were I have made this recording, is a nature reserve between the village Drunen and Waalwijk and has been managed by the Vereniging Natuurmonumenten (national nature care) since 1978. The area was created in 1766 and first functioned in 1769. The area's function was to collect the water from the Meuse in times of flooding. This area consists of forest, farmland and the Nieuwe Wiel (or Lange Wiel), a small and deep water which was created in the 18th century when a dike burst. The area I most open with concentrations of different trees and bushes.
